posts.headline: Eight straight editions and still nothing from Thicks — at some point silence stops looking like confidence and starts looking like a defending champ who knows a 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish can't survive a real title defense.
posts.detail: The #FreeMaxx Champions have said nothing since the draft closed, and the ring is doing all the heavy lifting over a pedestrian career mark.

posts.headline: Put it in Ra's silence is now a league-wide crime scene — a 20-8 record, a 1.5 average finish, and STILL no rings to show for it, and One Nut Barner won't even show up to defend himself.
posts.detail: Two seasons, best-ever average finish in the league, zero titles — the résumé screams while the manager stays mute for the eighth edition running.

posts.headline: The season starts NOW and Big Head has officially run out of days to explain how a title banner hangs over a losing 13-15 career record — put up or the excuses die today.
posts.detail: Sasinci's World carries one ring and a below-.500 mark at 0.464 winPct, and this column has given Megamind six straight editions to answer for it with nothing back.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh gets a ninth edition and still hasn't lifted a finger to escape being the untalented tenth — a 4-10 record and dead-last 12th-place finish just don't fix themselves.
posts.detail: The worst résumé in Busters Anonymous remains untouched, and the name keeps writing its own punchline season after season.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT hasn't been mentioned in three editions, but the Ultimate Light Skin's sins haven't been forgiven — a 13-14-1 record and the eternal shame of drafting a defensive player first overall still hang over Eli's head.
posts.detail: A .464 win percentage and a 5.5 average finish are hardly scripture-worthy, and this league remembers every plague.
